candidates.summary: RegisterExtension accepts a view that is also the hook, so a published view can hand any consumer OnMint/OnTransfer/OnBurn, which run under the issuer realm's authority
candidates.failure_scenario: The PR's own tests register one object as both (ledger.RegisterExtension(view, view) at grc721reg_test.gno:277,355,502). An issuer copying that shape publishes the hook through Token.ExtensionView and grc721reg.GetExtension; any realm asserts it to grc721.Extension and calls OnBurn(tid), and per the borrow rule the write commits in the issuer's state, corrupting its index. The shipped Enumerable/Metadata/Royalty views are separate types with no mutators, so the risk is latent. A guard 'if _, ok := view.(Extension); ok { panic }' closes the shape (exported-pointer-leak pattern).
candidates.verify_by: filetest with an issuer realm registering a struct implementing Extension and ExtensionView as both arguments, registering in grc721reg, and a second realm calling GetExtension(key,k).(grc721.Extension).OnBurn("1"); observe the issuer's state change
